Build a Disk-Backed Exact Cell-Graph Distance Store

Source: R/exact_ot_disk.R
build_graph_distance_store.Rd

Computes exact cell-graph shortest-path distances in resumable row blocks and writes a row-major, double-precision binary matrix for disk-backed clone OT.

Usage

build_graph_distance_store(
  graph,
  path,
  cells = NULL,
  cell_ids = NULL,
  block_size = 256L,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

graph

An undirected igraph cell graph with finite, non-negative edge costs in its weight attribute.

path

Output path ending in .bin.

cells

Optional endpoint-cell identifiers or graph indices. Paths may still traverse every graph vertex.

cell_ids

Optional unique identifiers in graph-vertex order.

block_size

Number of source rows written per resumable block.

overwrite

Whether to replace an existing store and metadata sidecar.

verbose

Whether to report completed row blocks.

Value

A validated clonotrace_distance_store object.

Details

The store requires 8 * n_endpoint^2 bytes. It lowers peak memory and permits reuse, but does not change or approximate the distance objective.
